newsitem.title: THAILAND: Diana Department opens below IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Diana Department opens below IPO price.

text.p: Diana Department Store Plc started weakly on its debut on the Thai stock exchange on Wednesday as its shares began trading at 11.50 baht, four baht below its initial public offer price of 15.50.
The stock was untraded for the first 10 minutes of dealings. By 0316 GMT, the share had slipped to 11.25 baht.
The stock firmed slightly to 12 baht by 0335 GMT.

"Diana Department stock isn't receiving much interest from investors because the firm is located up country and it has offered only a small amount of shares in the market," said Padermpob Songkroh of Nava Finance and Securities.
The head office of Diana Department Store is located in the southern district of Hat Yai. It has three branches, all of which are located in southern provinces.
The firm offered three million shares for sale in the market.
